name: Bugsink
composeYaml:
services:
  mysql:
    image: 'mysql:latest'
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ROOT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-bugsink}'
      - 'MYSQL_USER=${BUGSINK_USER}'
      - 'MYSQL_PASSWORD=${BUGSINK_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'my-datavolume:/var/lib/mysql'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mysqladmin
        - ping
        - '-h'
        - 127.0.0.1
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
  web:
    image: bugsink/bugsink:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - SECRET_KEY=${BUGSINK_PASSWORD}
      - 'CREATE_SUPERUSER=admin:${BUGSINK_PASSWORD}'
      - BASE_URL=${APP_URL}
      - 'DATABASE_URL=mysql://${BUGSINK_USER}:${BUGSINK_PASSWORD}@mysql:3306/${MYSQL_DATABASE:-bugsink}'
      - BEHIND_HTTPS_PROXY=True
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'python -c ''import requests; requests.get("http://localhost:8000/").raise_for_status()'''
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
